note: Synthetic structures written for this benchmark (rule 4). A drawing reaches a task when the identity of its SMILES (mzlab-mol Mol::can: atom order and Kekule form do not matter, stereo does) equals the target's and its objects are the listed ones.

tasks.goal: Draw the steroid skeleton gonane (three six-membered rings and one five-membered ring, all single bonds)
Draw N-ethyl tert-butyl carbamate with the Boc abbreviation (an ethylamine carrying Boc)
Draw ethanol + acetic acid, an arrow with the condition text H+, and ethyl acetate
Draw benzene, ethanol and acetic acid in a row, separated by two plus signs
Draw three molecules of ethane in a row and join them with two arrows, each anchored to the structures it joins (a two-step chain)
Draw one molecule of ethane in the middle and four more around it, each reached by an arrow from the middle one (a star of four)
Draw a parent molecule of ethane with three product molecules of ethane, an arrow from the parent to each (a parent with three transformation products)

Draw methylcyclohexane and five transformation products with an arrow from the parent to each: a demethylation, two hydroxylations, a ring opening, and a hydroxylation of the first hydroxylation product (a TP of a TP, its arrow leaves that product)
